name: Tiffany Square (Tiffany Square Apartments)
headline: Related Affordable is buying and renovating Tiffany Square, an existing 52-unit project-based Section 8 tax credit complex for families at 935 Sheridan Blvd in Lakewood's Molholm Two Creeks neighborhood. It won a 2025 federal 4% credit award from CHFA with bonds from Metro West Housing Solutions.
why_it_matters: A preservation deal for a mostly two-bedroom family Section 8 property near the W Line, financed with Lakewood's bond cap: the city assigns its cap to Metro West each year, and here the housing authority lends the bond proceeds to the Related buyer.

status.label: Bond approval granted June 2026; acquisition closing not confirmed
status.detail: Lakewood City Council approved the TEFRA resolution for up to $25M of Metro West bonds on 2026-06-08. No public record found confirms the bond sale, the acquisition closing or the start of renovation.

next_step: Watch for the Metro West bond issue and closing, the recorded deed to Tiffany Square Preservation, L.P., and Lakewood building permits for the rehab.

background.text: Metro West held the TEFRA public hearing by teleconference on 2026-03-13; no one appeared and no comments were received.

Lakewood City Council adopted R-2026-42 on the consent agenda on 2026-06-08 by a 10-0 vote, approving up to $25M of Metro West bonds for the project for federal tax purposes only; the city carries no liability for the bonds.
On the same consent vote the council adopted R-2026-41, assigning $10,593,609 of the city's 2026 bond cap to Metro West.

The property is already restricted under the tax credit program and a project-based Section 8 contract; the seller, sale price and the length of any extended affordability term are not in the public records found.
Related Affordable is also the CHFA sponsor of two other 2025 rolling 4% preservation awards, Squire Village (Northglenn) and Dawson Square.
